purpose: Close a reproducibility/fairness gap in the already-routed matched German Qwen3-ASR versus faster-whisper comparator without creating a new benchmark or runtime dispatch.

current_project_basis.gap: The existing handoff requires an admitted Whisper/faster-whisper baseline but does not itself bind the baseline package version, resolved model revision/artifact identity, device/compute type, beam/search options, thread count, language mode, previous-text conditioning, or VAD semantics. Those choices can materially affect both WER and latency.

fresh_primary_source_observations.official_vad: Silero VAD integrated; vad_filter is configurable and batched transcription enables VAD by default
fresh_primary_source_observations.official_comparison_warning: Performance comparisons must use similar transcription options, especially beam size, and CPU comparisons should control thread count such as OMP_NUM_THREADS.

required_runtime_binding_before_quality_: Persist the exact faster-whisper package version and installed wheel/source digest; do not rely on an unpinned mutable environment.
Persist the exact resolved CTranslate2 model repository revision plus artifact/file digests actually consumed; do not treat the string alias large-v3 as sufficient provenance.
Persist device, compute_type, beam_size, language, condition_on_previous_text, temperature/search settings, CPU thread count and library/runtime versions.
For the RAW faster-whisper arm, disable internal VAD so decoder behavior is not silently helped by a model-specific gate.

For the GATED arm, apply the same deterministic external VAD/turn-admission decision contract used for the corresponding Qwen gated arm; do not substitute faster-whisper's internal Silero VAD as hidden comparison authority.

If an existing admitted Frankenstein faster-whisper baseline already fixes a different exact model/version/configuration, preserve that baseline and record it instead of silently replacing it with this source delta's provisional reference configuration.
Record OMP_NUM_THREADS or equivalent effective CPU thread count and keep it fixed for latency comparison arms unless a separately labeled resource-scaling experiment is intended.
Keep FLEURS speech WER/CER separate from non-speech false-text activation, as already required by the scoring-integrity addendum.

provisional_reference_configuration_if_n.gated_vad_authority: same external deterministic admission contract as Qwen gated arm
provisional_reference_configuration_if_n.note: This is a reproducible reference configuration, not a target-runtime observation and not a requirement to overwrite a newer already-admitted project baseline. The executor must still resolve and pin the exact model revision/artifact hashes before inference.

hypothesis: A fully pinned faster-whisper baseline will prevent decoder/search/VAD/thread differences from being mistaken for Qwen-versus-Whisper model quality differences.
counterhypothesis: The existing executor may already have an exact admitted baseline configuration outside the currently inspected handoff; if so this delta should only add provenance/fairness checks and must not create a second baseline.
falsifier: If the current Trigger4 executor can produce a pre-existing exact faster-whisper package/model/configuration receipt bound to the same T7-ASR-004 semantic key and matched inputs, classify the baseline-pin gap as already closed and use that exact baseline rather than the provisional reference configuration.
next_exact_action: Bind these provenance and fairness requirements into the existing T7-ASR-004 Trigger4 comparator handoff; then the existing target executor runs the already-pinned FLEURS de_de rows 0..31 plus non-speech strata without creating another semantic objective or duplicate dispatch.
